what: While scrolling down a long section (350vh), a one-screen panel stays pinned, and ten screen-capture panels gathered around the center text spread to their own outer spots (±.48 of screen width · ±.43 of height) and fly toward the camera from depth −60~−260px to +820~+1170px, passing by. Each panel has different start · end · reveal · spread ranges so they arrive staggered, a 7px blur layer clears as they appear (spread reaches 1 at the .12~.25 share), size goes .9→1.18 and tilt relaxes by 55% as they pass, and they vanish in the last 8% of their range. It starts leaving 20% at the top of the section, ends at 90%, and follows scroll progress by .11 (.15 on phone) per frame

options.lead: Share of (section height − screen) that advances the start, default .2 — starts when the section header is this far down from the top of the screen
options.span: Leading share used for motion during scroll, default .9
options.fade: Share until fully visible after reveal, default .12
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: One-screen panel that stays pinned (required) — perspective is applied
options.[data-fx-part=plane]: Flying-in cards (placed in table order) — duplicates the first child (photo slot) as an extra blurred layer. Uses up to 10 cards on wide screens, 8 on tablet and 6 on phone, and hides the rest

use: Center copy
note: The original draws the plates every frame with gsap.set (same here). The white bloom behind the center text is css on the user side. In the original it is a white ellipse spreading −120 −210px around the text

from.where: index.html .hm-dose — the ”Once more?” section, 10 lab work captures fly in spread out
